what_it_decides: the template variable enable_thinking; unset leaves the template's own default, thinking on
what_settles_it: the server's preset, read from a live server

what_it_decides: the template variable reasoning_effort; unset leaves the template's own default, xhigh, and its sentence at the top of the system turn
what_settles_it: the server's preset, read from a live server

what_it_decides: the template variable preserve_thinking; unset leaves the template's own default, earlier thinking kept. With false the template drops the thinking of answers before the last user message. A session has one user message, the description, so its text is the same either way; a conversation with a later user message would no longer be one text that only grows, and the converter refuses it
what_settles_it: the server's preset, read from a live server

what_it_decides: text put before the first turn; the template writes none. The server reported the begin token <|endoftext|>
what_settles_it: the server's own rendering of one request

what_it_decides: which characters the template's trim removes at the ends of every text: jinja2 removes all Unicode white space, c_isspace only space, tab, line feed, vertical tab, form feed and carriage return (what the server's source does)
what_settles_it: the server's own rendering of a text that ends in such a character

what_it_decides: the text between two items when the template writes a value as JSON (tool lines, parameters that are not text)
what_settles_it: the server's own rendering of the tool lines

what_it_decides: the text after a key when the template writes a value as JSON
what_settles_it: the server's own rendering of the tool lines

what_it_decides: whether non-ASCII characters inside a JSON value are written as \uXXXX
what_settles_it: the server's own rendering of a parameter that holds non-ASCII text

what_it_decides: whether <, >, & and ' inside a JSON value are written as \uXXXX, as Jinja2's stock filter does
what_settles_it: the server's own rendering of the tool lines

what_it_decides: the template engine's trim_blocks setting, which decides the white space between the template's blocks
what_settles_it: the server's own rendering of one request

what_it_decides: the template engine's lstrip_blocks setting, which decides the white space between the template's blocks
what_settles_it: the server's own rendering of one request

what_it_decides: remove the maker's generation tags before rendering; they write nothing, and Jinja2 does not know them
what_settles_it: the server's rendering of the tuned file

what_it_decides: the order of a call's parameters: stream is the order the teacher wrote, read from the reply stream; sorted is the alphabetical order of the stored requests
what_settles_it: the model's raw reply on a live server, beside the template's writing of the same call

what_it_decides: a number the teacher wrote with a fraction of zero (120.0): as_integers writes 120, as the agent's JSON.stringify does before the server sees it; keep writes 120.0
what_settles_it: one such call sent through the agent to a live server

what_it_decides: the reasoning_content key of an answer without thinking: left out, an empty text, or null
what_settles_it: one answer without thinking recorded on the bench's route

what_it_decides: the tool_calls key of an answer without calls (the closing words): left out, or an empty list
what_settles_it: the agent's request after a closing answer, recorded on the bench's route

what_it_decides: the token that ends a turn, as the server reported it; the model's own writing in a turn ends with it
what_settles_it: recorded: the server's report in the target-text folder
